solution:
"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/excel-sheet-column-title/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

168. Excel Sheet Column Title

Given an integer columnNumber, return its corresponding column title as it appears in an Excel sheet.

For example:

A -> 1
B -> 2
C -> 3
...
Z -> 26
AA -> 27
AB -> 28
...

Example 1:

Input: columnNumber = 1
Output: "A"

Example 2:

Input: columnNumber = 28
Output: "AB"

Example 3:

Input: columnNumber = 701
Output: "ZY"

Constraints:

    1 <= columnNumber <= 2^31 - 1
"""


class Solution:
    def convertToTitle(self, columnNumber: int) -> str:
        result = []
        while columnNumber > 0:
            columnNumber -= 1
            remainder = columnNumber % 26
            result.append(chr(ord("A") + remainder))
            columnNumber //= 26
        return "".join(reversed(result))


sol = Solution()

print(sol.convertToTitle(1))  # "A"

assert sol.convertToTitle(1) == "A"
assert sol.convertToTitle(28) == "AB"
assert sol.convertToTitle(701) == "ZY"

assert sol.convertToTitle(26) == "Z"
assert sol.convertToTitle(27) == "AA"
assert sol.convertToTitle(52) == "AZ"
assert sol.convertToTitle(53) == "BA"
assert sol.convertToTitle(702) == "ZZ"
assert sol.convertToTitle(703) == "AAA"
assert sol.convertToTitle(18278) == "ZZZ"
assert sol.convertToTitle(18279) == "AAAA"
assert sol.convertToTitle(2147483646) == "FXSHRXV"
assert sol.convertToTitle(2147483647) == "FXSHRXW"
assert sol.convertToTitle(1000) == "ALL"
assert sol.convertToTitle(1000000) == "BDWGN"
